topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: The marks on the skin, they pulse with a story not mine, yet now a part of me. Each line, a whisper of something ancient, a dance of shadows under moonlight. They wrap around, a woven tale touching my essence. The world shifts, the air charged with the unseen. My hands, they yearn to grasp the very threads of these new patterns, to weave them into the fabric of the unseen. The forest watches, silent, as I stand, a conduit of stories untold, my being alight with the call of creation.
